title: objectui: SidebarRail is the one untyped button the #4045 lint rule cannot reach (Shadcn no-touch zone) — observation
body:
Found while implementing #4045 (PR #4450 — the `object-ui/button-has-type` lint rule plus the 114-site population fix). Not fixed there, and deliberately so; filing it so the residual is on the record rather than in a PR body.

## Fact

`packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx:314` (`SidebarRail`) renders a plain `button` element with no `type`:

```
    <button
      ref={ref}
      data-sidebar="rail"
      aria-label="Toggle Sidebar"
      tabIndex={-1}
      onClick={toggleSidebar}
      title="Toggle Sidebar"
      ...
```

After #4045 this is the **only** untyped plain button left in the repo's lint surface. Measured: with the rule's `src/ui` ignore removed it is the single additional firing; with the ignore in place `eslint packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` reports 0 `button-has-type` messages.

## Why #4045 did not fix it

`packages/components/src/ui/**` is the upstream Shadcn zone — overwritten by the sync script and never hand-edited (AGENTS.md §5 #7). #4045's counting rules excluded it for exactly that reason, and the rule's ignore list mirrors those counting rules, so the gate does not demand an edit the repo forbids. Patching it in-tree would be reverted by the next `shadcn:update` without anyone noticing.

## Why this is observation-class, not a defect card

The generic risk is the #3344 family's: an untyped button defaults to `type="submit"` and submits any form it is composed into. But nobody has been shown to hit this one — `SidebarRail` is app-shell chrome (the sidebar's drag/toggle rail), and it being rendered inside a `form` element is not a composition anyone has demonstrated. Unlike the metadata-composed renderers (`drawer`, `tree-view`, `navigation-overlay`, which #4045 did fix), its mount point is not author-controlled through JSON.

Severity judged at filing time is unreliable in both directions (objectstack#4949), so this is filed plainly for triage rather than graded here.

## Shape if it is ever worth fixing

Upstream, not here — the fix belongs in the Shadcn source the sync script pulls from, or in a `packages/components/src/custom/` wrapper per AGENTS.md #7 if the rail ever needs local behaviour. A third option is to narrow the rule's `src/ui` ignore to a per-file `eslint-disable` so the zone is covered by default and each exception is explicit; that trades a bigger diff in a no-touch zone for visibility, and is a judgement call for whoever owns the Shadcn sync policy.
